text: In February 2016 Bain Capital, GIC and Advent International invested about US$350 million in total to buy minority stakes in Quest Global. In August 2021 Business Standard reported that Bain Capital, Advent and GIC remained invested, and in August 2023 DealStreetAsia wrote that Quest Global's investors include GIC, Singapore's sovereign wealth fund.
short: GIC, Singapore's state fund, bought a minority stake in Quest Global in 2016; its size is not published.
